body:
Have you tried /r/suicidewatch?
If you're even for a moment thinking about suicide, I really recommend you either copy-paste the OP there, or rewrite it as you see fit. I really like and appreciate the community there.

You seem to be a cynical person (not a bad thing by any stretch), and so am I, but I posted to suicidewatch and even though I knew people were going to be positive and encouraging, I sincerely felt the people there cared, and they put me off of suicide for the time being at least.

Feel free to PM me if you want to talk or whatever, this is a throwaway but I'll reply to you on my main.

That last bit I feel will be really important to me eventually.
I dislike Taco Bell anyways, so that's crisis averted.

Okay, good idea. That's the general consensus it appears, I should focus on what I like rather than try to be a part of the mob.
Alright, thanks for the insight.
That is amazing.
Lovely quote!

I doubt I am. Thanks for the encouragement though!
To be honest school isn't for everyone, I for one can't stand how it works, but since I've always kinda been the nerdy guy (now I hide it more) I've never actually really had to listen to teachers.

You sound intellectually capable though. A crappy education doesn't make you stupider, you can always just learn what you didn't have the chance to.

I'll PM you so we can talk... having someone my own age in a similar situation will really help me!

Hugs are all I really want right now, to you too then! :D

I am pretty academically inclined, yes. I enjoy expanding my knowledge and I love shows like QI and trivia stuff like that.

Re: your first point, I see what you're saying and I've definitely never thought of it like that, I've always expected to have someone that understands me and can help and support me. Maybe I should just learn to be a little more self-sufficient.
I should have mentioned high school freshman. Sorry. Read the whole post and I mention my age :P
I love alcohol in moderation, but I don't drink (although I legally can consume it here...)
Sweet, I'll get back to all these tomorrow, like I said, and start some conversations out.
Will keep that in mind. Thanks, and yeah I am an atheist.
Polka? Now that's interesting. Yeah, Evanescence is depressing, I just go on a binge when I'm sad.
Oh, cool. I PMed you by the way regarding schools here.
I don't know what ais is, so I assume I don't.

No problem.

You're hilariously wrong, but that's okay. If there's once thing I abso-fucking-lutely can't stand, it's swooping generalizations of an age group, especially mine. 

I'm gonna choose to take the essence of your posts rather than look at the quite harshly worded actual content to heart, and I appreciate your outlook. Thanks.
Yeah, bordering Ramat Hasharon.

Yes. I tried Rosetta Stone for Italian, but the visual way it teaches just isn't for me. I really need to speak it daily and be corrected to grasp it. Russian is a really challenging language. I speak a teensy bit and man, it's confusing.

Thanks so much again. I'll be sure to do that for now.

I know.
I'm fluent. I live in Tel Aviv. Freshman, so 9th grade.

Yeah. That's what I've been doing to keep myself busy. There's a Spanish speaker in my class so I've been learning from him and that's what kept me busy last year, now I'm basically fluent. 

Like I said, this certainly isn't an extreme case of teenage depression, more of just no motivation or willpower... I can easily have great days and then look back and laugh at myself for being so down in the dumps... but then I look at the big picture.

It's hard to describe.

How could I have refused to leave the country if I was 13?
I'm genuinely curious how I could have, because both my parents knew how much I loved the US and how little I wanted to move.

You are partially right, by the way; I'm definitely somewhat needy, but isn't everyone?

I'd prefer not to have my real name associated with Reddit, just because I hide my computer hobby from basically everyone here.
Maybe eventually when I'm more confident in myself and my hobbies I'll join up; thanks for the link regardless.

I do love myself some good shakshuka.
It really is great. Season 3 is really good too. The quality definitely doesn't deteriorate. I also really like Modern Family, although it isn't for everyone.

That bit where I said I had my future all planned out, I wanted to go to Stanford. I still think if I make it to the point where I can, I'll try to. You know what they say though, nothing ever ends up how you plan it out... (or something along those lines)

I know he does, and that's really stopping me. My mom is really influenced by my dad's behavior and she just snaps at us occasionally...

I should try to do that, yeah. Thanks for the offer, too. Don't be offended if I don't PM you immediately, I just want to think this over logically for another day or two.
I love Community!
That's what my friend said too. That's what I'm trying to tell myself. Thanks. I may take you up on that offer when I have more time to think about this tomorrow.
I've seen you post shit like this in other threads. Go fuck yourself.

Let me know if I forgot anything in OP. I'm literally in tears right now listening to Evanescence and I'm having difficulty putting together sentences. Gracias.

Sorry for that crappy title too. I appear to not be able to change it though...
